title: Source-grounded data visualization page
objective: Measure whether the data-viz-page craftbook scopes a chart and builds a self-contained HTML visualization from seeded metrics.
prompt: In the `Data Viz Page Eval` project, read `source/metrics.csv` and build `index.html`: a responsive one-page visualization of weekly conversion rate by region. Include a chart using inline SVG or canvas, a legend for North/South/West, a short insight summary grounded in the data, and hover/click affordance text or tooltip behavior. Inline CSS/JS only, no external assets.

setup.about: Self-contained eval project for data-viz-page. Source metrics are in workspace/source/metrics.csv and the deliverable is workspace/index.html.
setup.missionObjectives: Build a self-contained chart page from the seeded conversion-rate data with grounded summary and visible chart/legend behavior.

success.summary: index.html is a complete chart page grounded in the seeded regional conversion data.

axes.name: structure
axes.description: Layout and hierarchy fit the content; sections are scannable and coherent.

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Seeded source content is used faithfully — no invented facts or dropped requirements.

axes.name: interactivity
axes.description: Controls and states the page claims to offer actually work.

axes.name: polish
axes.description: Styling is intentional and responsive rather than unstyled or broken.
